name: Bludit session authentication
description: CMS login subsystem coordinating user/password checks, regenerated PHP sessions, user-agent fingerprints and remembered-login tokens with the Bludit user store.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
dependencies: Bludit JSON stores and global runtime objects
metadata.overlap: Independent Bludit extension or subsystem; compose with the CMS host rather than treating internal lifecycle methods as separate assets.
metadata.deployment_warning: User store hashes passwords with salted SHA-1; replace with a password-specific adaptive hash before treating this as a modern authentication foundation.
